title: Wireframe Provenance Audit
scope: Validate wireframe PNG as geometric reference artifact. No render comparison.

authoritative.designScale: 1:1 metric — horizontal and vertical proportions match intended page geometry
authoritative.exportChain: Google Drawings → PDF → PNG at 1600 px width (uniform resize only, aspect ratio preserved)
authoritative.transformsExcluded: No non-uniform stretch, no separate X/Y scaling, no local section deformation

creationChain: Google Drawings → PDF → PNG @ 1600 px uniform width
User attached images in Cursor chat (Jul 14, 2026)
repositoryDelivery.gitHistory: Wireframe files untracked in git at time of audit

automatedFileInspection.misnamedExtension: All reference files use .png extension but contain JPEG data
automatedFileInspection.lossyCompression: JPEG baseline encoding — pixels have undergone lossy quantization; grid is not lossless

cropResizeResampling.fullVsCrop: 557×1024 full-page export vs 1024×1022 page-1 crop — different aspect ratios, incompatible pixel grids
cropResizeResampling.verdict: Crop is NOT a uniform-scale resample of full wireframe — width scale ~1.91× vs height scale ~1.00×

logical2048Claim.derivation: Assumes exactly 2× vertical scale (1024→2048) with no file metadata proof

sideMargins.note: Full export includes asymmetric viewport chrome (left margin 21px, right 0px)

scaleTests.label: wireframe canvas width → 1432, file height → 2048 logical
wireframe canvas width → 1432, file height → 3530 render

crossFileScales.note: If crop were a uniform-scale derivative of full, width and height ratios would match

uniformScaleVerdict.question: Can entire wireframe map to Desktop Canvas 1432px with one uniform scale factor?

details.label: wireframe canvas width → 1432, file height → 2048 logical
wireframe canvas width → 1432, file height → 3530 render

uniformScaleVerdict.retina2xWidthMismatch: 536×2 = 1072 ≠ 1432 — clean 2× retina mapping to implemented canvas width fails by 360px
uniformScaleVerdict.scaleDivergencePoint: Divergence begins at reference selection: full (557×1024) and crop (1024×1022) cannot share one scale factor. Mapping to Desktop Canvas 1432px requires sx≈2.672; mapping to 2048 logical height requires sy=2.0 — anisotropy Δ≈0.672 before any render comparison.

internalIsotropy.question: Is vertical pixel scale equal to horizontal scale within wireframe-full?
internalIsotropy.withinFilePixels: File pixel grid is rectilinear (1 file px = 1 file px in X and Y)

designElementCheck.note: Sub-pixel element measurement unreliable on JPEG; isotropy assessed via cross-file scale ratios and Desktop Canvas mapping

internalIsotropy.mappingToDesktopCanvas: Mapping wireframe canvas (536px) to implementation (1432px) and wireframe height (1024px) to any single target height (2048 or 3530) requires different scale factors — vertical and horizontal mapping to product coordinates are NOT interchangeable with one factor
internalIsotropy.verdict: Wireframe file is internally rectilinear but NOT linearly mappable to Desktop Canvas with uniform scale when height target ≠ width-derived scale

conclusion.supersedesAutomatedAudit: CS-14 addendum B (2026-07-15) — product owner documented provenance overrides automated file-inspection findings below
conclusion.summary: Reference wireframe is a geometrically valid design authority. Created in Google Drawings at 1:1 metric scale, exported to PDF, rasterized to PNG at 1600 px width with uniform resize only. Deviations between render and wireframe are implementation defects until proven otherwise.
conclusion.implementationInvestigationRule: If render ≠ wireframe, root cause is React/Tailwind/layout — not the reference artifact
conclusion.automatedAuditFindingsPreserved: File-format inspection (JPEG-in-PNG, chat upload chain) recorded for traceability; not grounds to reject reference without direct proof

addendumB.title: Reference wireframe — authoritative provenance
workflow: Wireframe manually drawn in Google Drawings (Google Obrázek)

Exported to PDF from Google Drawings
PDF converted to PNG at 1600 px width via uniform resize only (aspect ratio preserved)

authorityModel.domAuditScope: Proves React renders consistently — does not prove correct geometry vs design

addendumB.agentRule: Do not question reference PNG or its scale unless direct proof of reference error exists

CS-11.note: CS-14 addendum B restores wireframe as valid reference. Partial-crop limitation (top 29% only) remains a methodological constraint, not a reference invalidity.

CS-12.note: CS-14 addendum B restores wireframe as valid reference. Re-validate alignment methodology against 1600 px uniform-scale provenance.

CS-13.reason: Live DOM geometry audit — proves internal consistency, not design correctness vs wireframe
